items.title: Free home visit & quote
items.description: We visit, measure, talk through what you want, and send a clear written quote. No pressure, no fee.

items.title: Design & selections
items.description: We help you choose tiles, fittings and finishes within your budget, then agree the dates and order materials. You can buy your own suite and tiles if you prefer.

items.title: Build
items.description: You can stay at home while we work, and you have a working toilet every night. Floors are protected, we tidy up daily and keep you updated until the room is done.

items.title: Walkthrough & guarantee
items.description: We check every detail with you and back the work with a written 1-year workmanship guarantee.
